field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal prefix per Verdict Terminal-Prefix Discipline; accurately summarises which key claims succeeded.
field_principles.fover_shape_overfit_confirmed: Operationalized per task spec: true iff non-FoVer architecture-only AUROC < FoVer architecture-only AUROC by > 0.10. Cannot confirm without non-FoVer data.
field_principles.self_learning_contribution_confirmed: Operationalized per task spec: true iff FoVer learning_contribution > 0.05. The 0.05 threshold is 6.7x the measurement std of 0.0075.
field_principles.supersedes_capstones: Documents which prior deadlock-narratives this milestone supersedes, making the provenance chain auditable.
field_principles.corpora_headline_table: All numerical values from upstream measured artifacts only; null where blocked. Never inferred or interpolated.
field_principles.recommended_headline_repin: Drives paper-v6 §5 claim boundary. True = previous carry-forward headline is superseded by a more rigorous 5-seed replicated measurement.
field_principles.architecture_transfer_verifiers: Verifiers that generalize across multiple corpora. Requires ≥2 corpora with measured AUROC — impossible with current data.
field_principles.memory_augmented_verifiers: Verifiers whose AUROC increases materially when FR-11 memory is active.
field_principles.corpus_specific_verifiers: Verifiers that only signal meaningfully on one corpus type.
field_principles.low_signal_verifiers: Verifiers with AUROC near chance (0.5) across all measured corpora.
field_principles.gaps_for_270: Actionable gaps with concrete rationale — not wish-list items. Each gap names the blocking resource and the fix strategy.
field_principles.acceptance_criteria_met: Count of 10 acceptance criteria satisfied; honest gate tracking. 6/10 means the milestone made real progress but left 4 gaps.
field_principles.duration_s: Real synthesis wall-time; no sleep padding. The capstone is a JSON composition step — sub-second is expected and correct.
